en.p: The continuous random variable $X$ takes values in the range $0\le X\le a$, and the graph of the probability density function of $X$ is as shown in the figure.

en.p: When $\mathrm{P}(X\le b)-\mathrm{P}(X\ge b)=\dfrac{1}{4}$ and $\mathrm{P}(X\le\sqrt{5})=\dfrac{1}{2}$, what is the value of $a+b+c$? (Here $a$, $b$, $c$ are constants.) [4 points]
